unit.label: -less
unit.mentor_note: Less is the cheapest negation in English, which is why writers use it when they want the absence to sound total: not "with little hope" but hopeless.

predict_options.text: A smaller amount of the thing named

discovery.understand_note: Less removes entirely; it does not reduce. That absoluteness is the trap in many options: "careless" is not "less careful", it is without care.

applies.prompt: Knowing -less means without, and guile means cunning, what does guileless describe?

options.text: Someone innocent and sincere, with no cunning in them
Someone who is unusually clever and scheming
Someone who feels no guilt about what they have done
